authors: C. Gnendiger, A. Signer, D. Stoeckinger
title: The infrared structure of QCD amplitudes and H->gg in FDH and DRED
journal: Phys. Lett. B (2014), DOI 10.1016/j.physletb.2014.05.003 (volume/page not verified)
claim: NNLO gluon and quark form factors in FDH; the IR factorization formula is extended to FDH and DRED; cusp and quark/gluon anomalous dimensions are extracted at NNLO in FDH and DRED with MS-bar and DR-bar renormalization; the renormalization procedure in each scheme is described.
scheme: FDH and DRED with separately treated epsilon-scalars and evanescent couplings (details not read).

checked_partially: Scheme-dependence of IR anomalous dimensions at NNLO.

red_flags: Peripheral to SUSY; shows that IR anomalous dimensions become scheme (evanescent-coupling) dependent in FDH/DRED at NNLO.
